about.oneLiner: These text adventures were made with ChatGameLab: built by hand, without programming, told live by an AI.
about.details: Their makers describe the world, the characters and the rules in their own words. While you play, an AI keeps telling the story from there: it reacts to whatever you type and invents matching pictures — so no two rounds play out the same way. Building one yourself quickly shows how strongly your own instructions shape the result, and where an AI reaches its limits. That is the whole point: not having AI explained to you, but trying it out.

infoModal.body:
You've entered workshop mode. While in this mode, everything you do is linked to this workshop - games you create, play sessions, and share links.

You can leave anytime. Leaving won't end the workshop or remove anything you've created.
infoModal.headStaffNote: You can rejoin this workshop anytime from your organization's workshop list.
infoModal.individualNote: To rejoin after leaving, you'll need a new invitation from the workshop organizers.
